plugins.name: Monday.com
plugins.description: Seven skills for monday CRM users — first-run setup, morning briefings, forecast dashboards, board diagnosis, bulk data hygiene, workspace setup, and meeting-to-opportunity sync. Each skill publishes a monday artifact (update, doc, or dashboard) so work stays inside monday. Composes the official monday MCP connector; no custom server, no new auth.
